en.advancedHint: Limits and endpoint overrides. Provider API keys stay in the chain editor; credential slot names (*KeyEnv) are config-only.
en.announceHint: Say it out loud and play a chime when the agent stops for an approval or asks a question.
en.approvalHint: Said when an approval is asked for; the tool name is appended.
en.autoDetectHint: Guess zh/en per spoken piece instead of the language setting.
en.autoplayBlocked: Sound is blocked until you click or tap once
en.azureHint: Required for the azure provider, e.g. eastus.
en.bargeInHint: Stop reading the moment the microphone opens.
en.binHint: Looked up in PATH unless absolute.
en.cacheHint: Reuse synthesized audio for repeated phrases.
en.cacheMaxMbHint: Least recently used items are evicted first.
en.cardHint: Provider chain, voices and playback options.
en.chainHint: Top to bottom is the fallback order. Cloud keys are saved to the host credentials store, never into plugin settings.
en.chainHintCard: Pick a provider, paste its API key, and Save (or leave the key field). The key is written to the host credentials store immediately. The browser never reads it back.
en.confirmClearCache: Clear the synthesis cache? This cannot be undone.
en.confirmDeleteModel: Delete downloaded weights for this engine?
en.customBaseUrlHint: OpenAI-compatible origin, e.g. http://localhost:8880/v1; empty = off.
en.customKeyEnvHint: Credential name for the custom endpoint bearer key.
en.edgeHint: Python CLI from the edge-tts package.
en.enableItDictionaryHint: Auto-correct pronunciation for SQL, Nginx, K8s, Docker, API, JSON, YAML, etc.
en.enableLocalEnginesHint: Use Kokoro or F5-TTS when installed.
en.languageHint: Hint for voices that need a locale (eSpeak, Azure SSML).
en.localEnginesHint: Run speech synthesis 100% offline without API keys.
en.localProvider: Local / CLI provider — no API key
en.longReplyHint: truncate: cut at the limit; summarize: short retelling; full: read everything.
en.maxCharsHint: Hard cap before long-reply handling; 0 disables.
en.maxQueueHint: Drop oldest pending pieces beyond this count.

en.messengerIntegrationHint: Voice replies and notes sent through @goodandready/dsh-messenger-gateway.
en.messengerTtsEnabledHint: Allow the messenger gateway to deliver replies as voice notes.
en.mimoBaseUrlHint: MiMo API root; synthesis uses its chat endpoint.
en.minimaxBinHint: Looked up in PATH unless absolute; install and log in separately.
en.modelHint_f5: not bundled — offline neural runtime unavailable
en.modelHint_kokoro: not bundled — offline neural runtime unavailable
en.narrateQuotesHint: Read only «quoted» fragments of a reply.
en.openaiBaseUrlHint: OpenAI-compatible origin for the openai provider.

en.pronHint: Rules run top-down. Wrap left side in /…/ for a regex; Lang filters the rule.
en.questionHint: Said when the agent asks a question. Empty disables it.
en.rateHint: 0.5 to 2. Synthesis is untouched; the browser plays faster or slower.
en.removeRegexHint: Global regex; matches are removed before synthesis.
en.rolesHint: Empty fields inherit the main chain.
en.runtimeNotBundled: Neural inference runtime is not bundled

en.sentenceCharsHint: Max characters per streaming sentence piece.

en.speakAsItGoesHint: Read each reply the moment it lands, sentence by sentence, instead of waiting for the whole turn.

en.streamingEnabledHint: Play audio via AudioWorklet and SSE in real-time.

en.timeoutMsHint: Abort a provider attempt after this many milliseconds.
